notes.title: Patch 2
notes.content:
Added some quality of life improvements to improve the experience of the game for players.

Features:
- added middle mouse panning support

Fixes:
- Loading of custom board sizes are now quick to generate.
- Improved the speed of AI on large boards.

notes.title: Patch 1 - small update released
notes.content:
Thanks to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2855830/discussions/0/4295943021560534200/]feedback given[/url], I have made some updates to Reversi Temple.

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
- Fixed issue preventing the player to make a move unless the player moves the cursor off and back on the tile again.
- Fixed potential crash issue when completing a match
- Fixed not saving the number of games won used for Steam achievements

[h2]Updates:[/h2]
- Updated show/hide in-game hints icon from a question mark to a light blub for better context.
- Retain previous game settings state when returning to menu.

[h2]New features:[/h2]
- New game settings option to enable/disable in-game hints
- New game settings option to enable/disable coin animations
